category_name: Localized lighting, depth and bleak atmosphere without hiding geometry
scope: Category 5 only; mandatory-view obstruction separately recorded. No other category, technical, runtime, stability or cold-start approval.
strengths: Warm check-in and office pool is clearly separated from the cooler dock.
Counter, intercom, papers, desk and chair remain readable with restrained highlights and contact shadows.
Small indicators and fluorescent practicals avoid dominant neon bloom.
Institutional warm off-white, blue/charcoal equipment, orange doors and yellow routes remain coherent with the approved spawn grammar.
Deep secondary shadows support a bleak coercive atmosphere; exposure is visually consistent across the full set including recovered tail.

major_lighting_defects.issue: Primary scanner/cart faces are under-readable from worker height.
major_lighting_defects.visible_failure: Dark posts, control housings and cart leaves merge. Floor lanes, indicators and yellow patches carry more contrast than important construction.

major_lighting_defects.issue: Cargo top attracts excessive equipment emphasis while front mechanisms receive insufficient fill.
major_lighting_defects.visible_failure: Pale roof is the strongest equipment highlight; intake lip/control/lower roller construction is much weaker.

major_lighting_defects.issue: Support trolley lower forms merge into contact-shadow mass.
major_lighting_defects.visible_failure: Covered top reads faintly, but rail, lower shelf, chassis and wheels are insufficiently separated.

major_lighting_defects.issue: Overhead routing and arrival gate depth are insufficiently exposed.
major_lighting_defects.visible_failure: Bright tubes/selected beam edges contrast with nearly missing overhead services; large gate face and ribs remain weakly differentiated.

critical_visual_vetoes.visible_failure: A close beige foreground wall occupies roughly the left three fifths of the frame and hides most of the worker arch. Remaining inspection geometry is dark.
critical_visual_vetoes.gate: Every fixed view must pass. This hero evidence view is invalid.
critical_visual_vetoes.repair: Document the proven camera obstruction, establish an unobstructed replacement baseline, and rerender alongside unchanged mandatory worker views.

veto_scope_note: Outer scanner/cart silhouettes remain detectable; no whole-room unreadable-silhouette, flat-even-lighting, excessive-emissive, uniform-plastic or technical veto is asserted by this lighting-only review.

view_reviews.finding: Scanner uprights, cart leaves and control housings merge into dark masses; floor lanes and status dots carry the read.
Warm counter is legible and separated from cool dock; reflected glazing softens rear equipment but does not hide the counter.
Intercom, stamps, paper and counter edge have controlled local contrast. Black lower fascia is subordinate; small glazing reflection is not dominant glare.
Near-black columns/control housings expose little construction while illuminated route is much clearer.
Cool housing/ribs and cargo blocks read; intake lip and lower roller mechanics need restrained fill while tunnel stays dark.
Gate leaves, side assemblies and posts merge; orange patches and indicator dots carry functional contrast.
Warm pool gives chair/desk grounding and restrained screen focal point; rear dock is cooler.
Covered top is faintly legible but rail, shelf and lower chassis merge into black.
Gate face is too uniformly dark; ribs and header are weakly separated; beacons reveal insufficient construction.
Tube lights and selected beam edges read while much overhead routing/structure disappears into near-black field.
Warm office/cool dock separation and contact shadows read; cargo roof dominates inspection arch.
Functional zones read; bright cargo roof competes with check-in and support forms become dark cluster.
Warm office/cool cargo pools are visible; cargo top dominates and lower support forms are subdued.
Spatial depth survives; pale cargo top attracts more attention than arch; support hardware is weak.
Arch outline reads against rear wall but its front construction and cart leaves stay too dark beneath practical.
Scanner fronts read mainly as dark posts and bright dots; header and rear gate lack sufficient separation.
Cargo/service wall has readable cool planes and controlled lights; foreground scanner remains almost black.
Warm office wall, drawers, desk and counter read with soft falloff. Foreground scanner/partition dominate framing but office lighting failure is not established.
Close wall hides most intended subject; remaining inspection pieces are dark. Invalid mandatory hero coverage.
Housing ribs, container planes and conveyor silhouette read; intake lip/front face and lower mechanics need oblique fill.
Dim blue doors, frames, locks and restrained paper remain distinguishable; preserve lower hierarchy.
Cover and cabinet faces read, but rail, underdeck and wheels disappear into floor/contact-shadow mass.
Cool housings, conduits and cabinet faces remain distinguishable with restrained glow and wall shadows.
Counter papers, metal edges, folded item and stamp read without hot highlights; controlled work exposure.
Arch/cart construction remains dark; background floor/wall supplies outline but not important face readability.
Gate ribs, floor transition/drain, cart outline and utility cluster read with subdued practical pool.

priority_lighting_repairs.action: Reveal scanner/cart upright faces, recessed controls, leaf edges, side housings and lower rails with an oblique practical key and restrained bounce.
priority_lighting_repairs.preserve: Charcoal values, dark overhead space and limited indicators. Do not depend on dots/yellow paint for construction readability.

priority_lighting_repairs.action: Redirect cargo illumination away from pale roof dominance onto intake lip, adjacent control housings and roller edges.
priority_lighting_repairs.preserve: Dark examination tunnel; check-in and worker arch remain primary.

priority_lighting_repairs.action: Add a small motivated side/bounce pool to separate trolley cover, rail, caster boundaries and lower shelf.
priority_lighting_repairs.preserve: Dim evidence storage and bleak support bay below the check-in hierarchy.

priority_lighting_repairs.action: Use faint grazing/bounce from overhead practicals to distinguish beam, service routing and ceiling background.
priority_lighting_repairs.preserve: Predominantly dark ceiling; no decorative glowing service lines.

priority_lighting_repairs.action: Strengthen localized route falloff and graze arrival gate ribs/reveals enough to show depth.
priority_lighting_repairs.preserve: Current counter/paper exposure. Avoid global exposure increase or floor hotspots displacing scanner focus.
